name: Norfolk County, MA
findings: Norfolk County has 3,047 nonprofit organizations. 1,015 of them (33%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 827 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (14% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Norfolk County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in Norfolk County list public events in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 66% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 687 organizations here; 26% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find public events now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.title: Union organizations stand out for membership
observations.text: 35 union organizations here list membership, compared with about 16 in similar places of this size.

confidence.text: Based on 35 organizations here; 26% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What role do union organizations play in community life here? Who do they reach, and who might they miss?

observations.title: Few economic development organizations list public events
observations.text: 10 economic development organizations here list public events. In similar places of this size, about 21 would.

confidence.text: Based on 21 organizations here; 26% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Do people here look for public events through economic development groups? Where else does that happen?

observations.title: Foundation organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 334 foundation organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.

confidence.text: Based on 334 organizations here; 26% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do foundation organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?
